lead: Rani Mukerji is a widely followed Indian actor, born on 21 March 1978 in Mumbai.
As of 2026, she is 48 years old, and her birth date places her under the Aries sign.
She has 59 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Filmfare Critics Award for Supporting Best Actress and Zee Cine Award for Best Actor in a Supporting Role – Female.
The sections that follow break down Rani Mukerji's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Rani Mukerji — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Rani Mukerji was born on 21 March 1978 in Mumbai, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name her father, Ram Mukherjee and her mother, Krishna Mukherjee.
She studied at SNDT Women's University and Mithibai College.
